notes: After Mohács (1526) Hungary was split between Ferdinand of Habsburg and John Zápolya (an Ottoman vassal); the Ottomans annexed central Hungary only in 1541.
Mongolia was the Northern Yuan; the Tarim Basin was the Yarkent Khanate (1514).
Split the source map's 'Islamic and Hindu states' into the sultanates of Gujarat, Malwa, Bengal and Sindh and the Gajapati kingdom.
Greenland was unclaimed between the end of the Norse settlements and Danish recolonisation (1721).
Tunis (Hafsid) and Tripoli (Knights Hospitaller, 1530) were not Ottoman until 1551–74.
Filled gaps in the source map from the nearest map (within 50 years).
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
